title: Choose the visual world
question: The direction on the table is the Guard Chart. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Guard Chart
options.lineage: The numbered plastic guard set hung beside a barber's clippers
options.thesis: Every cut is a number, a minute count, and a barber, read the way a chair already reads a guard.
options.viewport: A full-width red guard plate stamped Prolific Cuts, with Diego, Roger, and Nic as three columns of numbered cuts and times.
options.risk: It can turn into a spec sheet and lose the welcome if the numbers crowd out the people.

options.label: Marquee Row
options.lineage: A dark arcade aisle, one lit cabinet per game
options.thesis: Each barber is a cabinet. You walk the row and commit to the chair whose marquee is lit.
options.case: A row of names is a clear way to pick a barber, and it loses because a dark aisle hides the minutes and a bright, kid-friendly room.
options.viewport: Three marquees in a dark row. The lit one opens that barber's times and prices.
options.risk: It reads as a club, which fights a shop that cuts toddlers' hair in daylight.

options.label: Select Rail
options.lineage: A film editor's cutting bench, frames held between pins
options.thesis: Services are frames on one strip. The minutes are the length of the frame, and a tape flag marks the cut in hand.
options.case: Frame length is an honest picture of duration, and it loses because this visitor is not an editor and orange-on-black is not this shop.
options.viewport: One horizontal rail of service frames, an orange flag on the chosen cut, three barbers hanging as trims below.
options.risk: The metaphor buries the address, the welcome, and which book you are actually joining.

options.label: One Painted Cut
options.lineage: A Polish film poster, one painted metaphor filling the sheet
options.thesis: The first screen is one painted head, and the shop name bends to follow it.
options.case: The craft is high, and it fuses poorly because one image cannot show three menus, three durations, and a clear book button.
options.viewport: One full-bleed painted portrait, Prolific Cuts lettered along the jaw, the three books tucked inside the contour.
options.risk: A visitor who needs a time and a booking link has to hunt for both.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.lineage: The barbershop website this category always ships
canonCard.thesis: A dark fade photo, a thin gold line, and a Book button.
canonCard.viewport: A full-bleed dark portrait, the shop name in a serif, one gold Book button.
canonCard.risk: It looks like every other shop and says nothing about a bright room or three separate books.
